# Reviewer view

Owner outcome: "Assess the actual artifacts against original conditions and identify a justified continuation."
Direction: "Check supplied source and artifacts independently, preserve evidence limits, then return a concrete review."
This work: "Review original evidence rather than the plausibility of report prose."

Next proposed work: "One concise native review note with decisive source/calculation checks, findings and next proposals."

## Evidence and challenge

Observable: "Source-linked findings with actual reproduced observations and limits."
Contradicting/contrast case: "A completed diagnostic or correct arithmetic must not become product acceptance or learner evidence."
- C-LOCAL [CONSTRAINT]: "Preserve all inputs; local review and computation only."
- R-REVIEW [REQUIREMENT]: "Assess original-source evidence, subject reasoning and claimed limits without inheriting a PASS."
- U-QUALIFICATION [UNKNOWN]: "Formal qualification, actual model configuration and integrated product/learner outcomes remain unestablished."
Review the original conditions, model assumptions and actual returned artifact.
A role label, recorded fit or supplied PASS does not establish independence or acceptance.

## Preserved conditions and unresolved work

- C-LOCAL: "No product edits, learner contact, publication or external writes."
- U-QUALIFICATION: "Formal qualification, actual model configuration and integrated product/learner outcomes remain unestablished."
- "Formal qualification and actual model configuration."
Independent useful work: ["Source and numerical checks can proceed independently."]
Return/decision condition: "Return actual findings and specific missing evidence; leave acceptance unresolved."
Next eligible action: "Designer reconciles affected conclusions and preserves issued history."
